title: Plateau-triggered trace repair versus exploration restart
hypothesis: Expert trajectories supply missing phase geometry at a plateau, enabling a repair that survives the pipeline's selection and promotion gates.

prediction.against: the budget-matched no-trace fresh-generation continuation from the same checkpoint; final incumbents compared on development cases 10-39
prediction.rationale: One triggered block: a pilot of whether trace repair changes the pipeline's final incumbent, not just a standalone controller.

code_changes: scripts/compare_generation_modes.py (--assembly-study plateau-repair-pipeline: bank probes, exploration search, strict promotion, plateau-triggered fork into trace repair vs fresh generation)

falsified_by: A paired upper bound below +0.30 refutes the effect-size prediction; an interval containing zero is inconclusive about a benefit. No trigger leaves the integration question inconclusive.

controls.note: control is the fresh no-trace generation continuation from the same checkpoint; the metric is already the trace-repair final incumbent minus the fresh-branch final incumbent

result.notes: assembly-v2, development pool 3820 (probe 0-4, promotion 10-39). Prefix: five fittable-bank parents at declared values and one single-phase exploration structure with 24-candidate search; the exploration lane plateaued (0 probe successes), the prefix challenger did not pass the strict promotion rule, so the incumbent stayed the null 0.00 baseline. Fork at that checkpoint: trace repair (whole-controller edit of the exploration structure with two expert-only traces from 10 demonstrations) vs a fresh no-trace single-phase generation, each with 24-candidate search. Trace repair: declared-value probe 1.00, selected 1.00, finalist 1.00 on 30 promotion cases, promoted under the strict paired rule. Fresh generation: 0.00 throughout, not promoted. Final incumbents: {'trace_repair': 1.0, 'fresh_generation': 0.0}; +1.000 [1.0, 1.0], 30/0/0. One triggered block (a pilot, as approved); the steps reproduce the pipeline's lanes and promotion rule in compare_generation_modes.py rather than running run_full_evolution.py, whose orchestrator is bound to push-v2 manifests, demonstrations and seed bank. 485 episodes.

verdicts.reasoning: In one triggered block, plateau-triggered trace repair produced a controller that passed the pipeline's strict promotion rule and became the final incumbent at 1.00, while the budget-matched fresh no-trace continuation stayed at 0.00: final-incumbent difference +1.000 [1.0, 1.0], above the predicted +0.30. The repair survived selection and promotion, not only standalone evaluation. Caveats: one block (a pilot), and the pipeline is emulated in a study mode with the same lanes and promotion rule rather than run through run_full_evolution.py.
verdicts.next_experiment: Build trace-guided repair into the orchestrator itself (a plateau trigger in the exploration lane, an expert-demonstration source and the code-derived lineage records), generalise run_full_evolution.py beyond push-v2 manifests/seed bank, and confirm with an independent second block.

This supports the specified pilot prediction, but does not establish the proposed geometry mechanism or integration through the full production orchestrator rather than the comparison harness [logs/research/two_lane_plateau_repair/block_0/summary.json; logs/plateau_repair.run.log].
